description: Save a price rule for one sales channel in one currency, step 2 of 2, after preview_channel_price_rule. Send the SAME platform, currency and rule with that preview's digest; a digest from an older preview is refused. Applies to every product on the channel on its next update, wherever the owner has turned price updates on, and to new listings; it never turns price updates on. Requires the workspace owner's switch for bulk price changes in Settings → Integrations → Connect AI, which is off by default. rule null removes the rule. Idempotent. The result echoes the workspace.

currency.description: The currency the rule applies in. list_channel_price_rules names the currencies each connected channel sells in.

digest.description: The digest returned by the preview of exactly this rule.

platform.description: The sales channel, e.g. ebay or amazon.

fixed.description: Amount added to the base price after the percent, in the rule's currency. 0 for none.

percent.description: Percent added to the base price: 15 sells at base + 15%. Negative lowers it, down to -50. 0 for none.

rounding.description: How the result is rounded: cents (to the cent), whole (up to a whole number), nine (up to a whole number ending in 9), tens (up to tens), ninety_nine (ending in .99).

rule.description: The rule to check. null removes it: the base price again.

name: set_channel_price_rule
title: Set channel price rule
